execution.policy: Market entry at next contiguous open plus half spread and adverse slippage. Signal brackets stay frozen. Recheck entry geometry, deviation and budget before taking a simulated fill. A single position or reserved order occupies the slot. Process known open gaps, then stop first when both extremes are touched. Limits execute at target prices, market and stop prices pay adverse slippage. Commission on each unit each way. S5 uses the observed +0.05R lock from the next bar after TP1, others keep fixed stops. Report net R on all-in stop risk; drawdown at chart closes. These are OHLC scenarios, not executable quotes or native broker fills.
execution.retrospective_episode_rule: Use the pinned directional event clock-hour protocol for both directions. Non-directional eligible hours are classified separately as reversal when two half-hour moves oppose, the second dominates and both exceed half the prior 24-hour median range, or sideways when net move is <=35% of range. No episode outcome enters the signal scan or portfolio.
